name: Certified Asbestos Investigators
description: This dataset lists certified asbestos investigators, with 611 records and five fields: last name, first name, certification number, expiration date, and telephone number. Each row represents one certified individual, and the expiration date indicates when their certification lapses. The data could be used to look up or verify an investigator's certification status, identify certifications nearing expiration for renewal outreach, contact certified professionals, or analyze the distribution and turnover of certified investigators over time.
